rationale: Reuses the existing uncertain_suffix opt-in-flag triad on EvaluateConfig with no new abstraction; abstention routing is already verdict-string-driven and evaluator-agnostic. Option B (dedicated harness_exit evaluator type) needs 6+ touch points; Option C (numeric route keys) has no precedent and breaks string-typed routing across 8 consumer files.
rule: Map exit 3 to cannot_judge in the exit_code evaluator via a per-state opt-in flag (Option A)
alternatives_rejected: Option B: dedicated harness_exit fragment/evaluator; Option C: numeric verdict keys in route:
